question: How fast is delivery and shipping?
answer: Orders are inspected and dispatched within 24 to 48 hours. Standard insured doorstep delivery typically takes 3 to 7 business days with full online tracking.

question: What is the quality of your home & garden items?
answer: All our products are crafted from premium, heavy-duty materials engineered for long-term home and garden durability. Every item undergoes rigorous quality control before shipping.

question: What happens if my package arrives damaged?
answer: Every shipment is 100% insured. In the unlikely event that an item is damaged during transit, contact us with a quick photo and we will dispatch a free replacement immediately.

question: Which payment methods do you accept?
answer: We accept all major credit and debit cards (Visa, Mastercard) and PayPal. All transactions are protected by bank-grade 256-bit SSL encryption.

question: Do you offer a money-back guarantee?
answer: Yes! We offer a 30-day hassle-free return and refund policy. If you are not completely satisfied with your purchase, reach out to our team for a smooth return or exchange.

question: How can I track my package or get assistance?
answer: As soon as your parcel ships, you will receive an email with your tracking number and live status link. Our customer support team is available 24/7 to assist with any questions.
